# Theory

$$x_t=y_{obs,t}-y_{sim,t}$$

```{r example}
p<-default_ar_parameters();assessment_table(assess(p));plot_ar(roots(p))
```

AR cannot reliably correct future timing errors. Check gaps, ratings and cut-offs before changing parameters.
